title: R41-T027 Banknote Authentication – SVM Reproducible Configuration & Fixture Schema
description: Data contract for the eight-row synthetic classification fixture and serializable SVM configuration. These synthetic rows are NOT observations from the UCI Banknote Authentication dataset and must NOT be cited as evidence of real-world or clinical performance.
